title: The phone's two bootloader copies differ
body: The phone keeps two copies of its system (slot A and slot B), each with its own bootloader. Omarchy Mobile starts from slot B, so both have to be the same version, and they are not (A: fake-1.0, B: fake-0.9).
With different versions the phone may not start from slot B. Google's own tools put the same version on both: the install guide says how.
footer: The installer only asked the phone what it is. It has written nothing to it.
Starting the installer again as things are will stop here again.
